_readme: Shared test cases for the rules (src/rules.js on the relay, the PC app on Windows). Times are Unix seconds. "decide" cases run on both sides: rules is the effective document, hours_utc and hours_until are what the relay sent with it, now is the time to judge at, args holds control, program, path and delay_s (for a restart or shutdown, the hour rules are judged over the whole window from now to now + delay_s). A case with "scope":"relay" is skipped by the PC, which expands short names and resolves relative paths and links before it compares. "validate", "effective" and "hours" run on the relay only: the PC never parses a customer override, merges one or works out business hours. "decide_posix" cases have the same shape for a Mac (paths from /, case-folded, .. resolved from the root) and run on the relay and in the Mac client; the Windows PC does not read them.
